name: Arabian Dreams: Wildest Tales in Starry Nights
source:
There is a kingdom called “Madinaba” in a big city in the desert. 
You are the princess of the kingdom, and your overprotective parents have forced you to remain in the palace all of your life. Tired of them, you try to sneak out to see what the world is like outside of the palace, but have never succeeded. 
…Until one day, a mysterious man named Ifrit appears before you and proposes that, if you spin a tale, he will let you out from the palace. When you answer “yes”, you are finally out of the palace for the first time in your life!

Their stories are supposed to have been already made, but you can change their fate out of your love as the tale-spinner.
How would you like your love story to change? Happy ending or sad ending? 
Their fate and the course of your romance are in your hands…

[from [url=http://www.nttsolmare.com/e/press/2016/e0212_2.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
沙漠中的大城市里，有一个名为“马迪纳巴”的王国。
你是这个王国的公主，过度保护你的父母让你一生都只能待在宫殿里。你厌倦了他们，试图偷偷溜出去看看宫殿外的世界，却从未成功。
……直到有一天，一名叫伊夫利特的神秘男人出现在你面前，提出只要你讲一个故事，就让你离开宫殿。你答应后，终于第一次走出了宫殿！

这些故事本应已经写就，但作为讲故事的人，你可以用自己的爱改变它们的命运。
你想让自己的爱情故事发生怎样的变化？幸福结局，还是悲伤结局？
他们的命运，以及你们恋情的发展，全都掌握在你手中……

[来自 [url=http://www.nttsolmare.com/e/press/2016/e0212_2.html]官方网站[/url]]
